quiz.name: 2027 Equities - Module 9 Industry and Competitive Analysis

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod9-Q1
entry.itemBody: Which of the following statements best describes the characteristics of growth companies?

choices.itemBody: A. Unlike defensive or cyclical companies, growth companies tend to exhibit smaller revenue declines in an economic downturn.
B. Unlike defensive or cyclical companies, growth companies tend to exhibit higher profitability during economic expansion.

C. Unlike defensive or cyclical companies, growth companies exhibit higher revenue growth independent of economic fluctuations. Feedback C is correct because growth company performance is relatively insensitive to the business cycle. A is incorrect because the revenue of growth companies is typically less related to economic cycles. B is incorrect because growth companies exhibit higher revenue growth, which may or may not be accompanied by high profitability.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod9-Q2
entry.itemBody: Which of the following statements provides the best justification for grouping companies using a geographic rather than industry approach?

choices.itemBody: A. Firms that face similar economic conditions in the same country may have more common value drivers than those in the same industry.
B. Firms listed on the same exchange may have more common value drivers than those in the same industry.

C. Firms that report financial statements in the same currency may have more common value drivers than those in the same industry. Feedback A is correct because companies operating within a jurisdiction may have more common value drivers due to political, economic, and social policies and conditions than those operating in various jurisdictions within an industry. B is incorrect because operating within the same industry typically results in more common value drivers relative to listing on a common exchange. C is incorrect because operating within the same industry results in more common value drivers relative to having the same reporting currency.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod9-Q3
entry.itemBody: Which of the following statements best describes the challenges of using a bottom-up approach to measure industry size?

choices.itemBody: A. A bottom-up approach is difficult to apply when government statistics for a specific sector are unavailable.
B. A bottom-up approach is difficult to apply when an industry classification involves a strict hierarchical taxonomy.

C. A bottom-up approach is difficult to apply when an industry includes a large proportion of private companies or small businesses. Feedback C is correct because it is more difficult to estimate revenue for private companies or small businesses than to access disclosures for large, publicly listed companies. B is incorrect because strict hierarchical taxonomies are not a challenge specific to a bottom-up approach to estimating industry size. A is incorrect because the lack of government statistics for a sector is a challenge for a top-down—not a bottom-up—approach to estimating industry size.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod9-Q4
entry.itemBody: Which of the following statements best describes third-party industry classification schemes?

choices.itemBody: A. Third-party classification schemes combine companies with a similar business model into the same industry.
B. Third-party classification schemes align companies to a single industry that represents their primary operating activity.

C. Third-party classification schemes assign the different activities of companies operating across industries to each of their different industries. Feedback B is correct because third-party classification schemes are based on a strict hierarchical taxonomy that assigns each company to a single industry. A is incorrect because companies within the same industry may have different business models. C is incorrect because companies operating across industries are assigned to a single industry that represents a firm’s largest business activity.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod9-Q5
entry.itemBody: Which of the following statements best describes the use of vertical integration as a competitive strategy?

choices.itemBody: A. Vertical integration may be used to expand operations into an earlier stage of production to offset supplier bargaining power.
B. Vertical integration may be used to outsource production to offset consumer bargaining power.

C. Vertical integration may be used to expand operations in order to reduce the threat of substitutes for an industry’s products or services. Feedback A is correct because vertical integration may be used to offset supplier bargaining power by expanding production to an earlier stage. B is incorrect because vertical integration involves the insourcing rather than the outsourcing of production processes. C is incorrect because vertical integration does not address the threat of substitutes for a company’s products or services.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod9-Q6
entry.itemBody: Which of the following statements best describes the contrast between the impacts of basic research and sustaining innovation on an industry?

choices.itemBody: A. Basic research involves developing an understanding of scientific principles, while sustaining innovation aims to minimize a firm’s environmental impact.
B. Basic research creates new industries, while sustaining innovation fundamentally changes existing businesses across multiple industries.

C. Basic research generally has no immediate commercial application, while sustaining innovation involves incremental improvements to existing products or services. Feedback C is correct because basic research involves discoveries with no immediate commercial impact, while sustaining innovation makes small improvements to existing products or services. A is incorrect because sustaining innovation does not necessarily address a product’s environmental impact. B is incorrect because basic research generally requires longer periods until commercialization, while breakthrough innovation fundamentally changes existing businesses across multiple industries.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod9-Q7
entry.itemBody: Which of the following sets of industry circumstances minimizes the threat of entry?

choices.itemBody: A. A greater proportion of intangible assets, lower network effects, and lower switching costs
B. A lower proportion of intangible assets, greater cost advantages, and less efficient scale

C. A greater proportion of intangible assets, higher network effects, and higher switching costs Feedback C is correct because more intangible assets, higher network effects, and higher switching costs all represent barriers to entry. A is incorrect because higher, not lower, network effects and switching costs deter industry entrants. B is incorrect because higher, not lower, intangible assets and more efficient scale are factors limiting industry entrants.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod9-Q8
entry.itemBody: Which of the following statements is consistent with lower industry concentration?

choices.itemBody: A. Lower industry concentration is consistent with a higher Herfindahl–Hirschman Index.
B. Lower industry concentration is generally consistent with greater competitive intensity.

C. Lower industry concentration is generally consistent with lower product differentiation. Feedback B is correct because lower industry concentration involves many industry participants supplying a good or service, which generally leads to higher competitive intensity. A is incorrect because lower industry concentration is consistent with a lower, not higher, Herfindahl– Hirschman Index. C is incorrect because product differentiation is not determined by the degree of industry concentration.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod9-Q9
entry.itemBody: Which of the following types of companies is most sensitive to economic conditions?

choices.itemBody: A. Cyclical
B. Growth
C. Defensive Feedback: A is correct. The performance of companies with cyclical demand for their products is highly variable and depends on economic conditions.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod9-Q10
entry.itemBody: Which of the following sectors is most likely considered defensive?

choices.itemBody: A. Financials
B. Industrials

C. Consumer staples Feedback: C correct because sectors such as consumer staples, healthcare, and utilities are considered defensive, while financials, basic materials, consumer discretionary, and industrials are considered cyclical
